verdict.rationale: The core Python library is hosted publicly on GitHub (github.com/browser-use/browser-use) and referenced repeatedly in docs and community discussion, implying open-source availability, but the evidence pack never cites the actual license file or name (e.g., MIT/Apache) confirming terms of use, and the Cloud/API/MCP-server components appear to be closed, hosted services rather than open-sourced code. missing for 10: explicit license identification/text, confirmation that all shipped components (not just the core library) are under an open license, and independent verification of license terms beyond repo existence.
